text: Never block a ThreadPool job on another job (no future.get() inside a task); express it as a JobGraph edge or it deadlocks once all workers wait.
Cooker tests: cmake --build --preset tools-release --target assetcooker_tests, then ctest --preset tools-release -R TextureCooker.
The asset cooker compresses textures single-threaded on purpose: nvtt is not thread-safe, so no parallel cooking.
bc7enc replaced nvtt for BC7; it is thread-safe per encoder instance, so give each worker its own encoder and never share one.
Asset cooker cache keys are source path + mtime; touch a texture to force a re-cook.
CookCache keys are xxh3(content) + cook settings + compressor version; mtime is ignored, use --force-recook to rebuild.
Configure with cmake -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' and build from the generated .sln.
Configure only via CMakePresets.json (Ninja Multi-Config), e.g. cmake --preset windows-ninja; the VS generator is unsupported.
BC7 golden tests compare PSNR >= 45 dB, not bytes: the AVX2 and SSE4 paths produce slightly different blocks.
Profile with Tracy: configure with -DEMBER_TRACY=ON and attach the Tracy viewer; each job shows as a zone with its wall time.
Threading changes must pass a TSan run (preset linux-tsan) before merge; most races only reproduce with 8+ threads.
Binary test fixtures (*.dds, *.ktx2) go through Git LFS; the pre-commit size hook rejects plain blobs over 1 MB.
Adding a vcpkg port: list it in vcpkg.json and in docs/third_party.md with its license, or the CI license check fails.
tools/shadercompiler caches DXC output in build/shadercache; delete it after upgrading DXC.
The editor's ThreadPool debug panel (editor/src/panels/ThreadPoolView.cpp) is compiled out of shipping builds.
Audio banks are built by the FMOD Studio CLI; tools/audiobuild only copies .bank files, it never transcodes.
New editor dock widgets must be registered in EditorMainWindow::registerPanels() or their layout isn't saved.
Navmesh agent radius and step height are tuned in data/nav/agents.toml, not in code.
Lua bindings are generated by sol2 from engine/script/bindings.yaml; rebuild the gen_bindings target after edits.
clang-format 18 with the repo .clang-format; CI fails on any diff. Run the 'format' target before pushing.
Commit subjects are prefixed with the module: assetcooker:, engine/core:, editor:, tests:, vcpkg:.
Tool binaries are signed only in CI; never hand local unsigned builds to artists, SmartScreen blocks them.
Warnings are errors (/W4 /WX, -Wall -Werror) for engine/ and tools/; third_party/ is exempt.
No exceptions in engine/; tools may throw but must catch in main() and return a non-zero exit code.
